t-shirt.definition: A casual knitted shirt, usually made of cotton, has short or absent sleeves, a round neckline, and no collar, and is worn informally.

shirt.definition: A garment worn on the upper body, usually with sleeves.

blouse.definition: A loose shirt-like garment usually worn by women.

sweater.definition: A crocheted or knitted garment covering the upper part of the body.

hoodie.definition: A soft sweatshirt has a hood, strings to tighten it, and a large front pocket.

tank-top.definition: A close-fitting sleeveless shirt has broad shoulder straps, a low neckline, and no opening down the front. It is often worn over a shirt or blouse.

polo-shirt.definition: A knitted shirt with short sleeves has a soft collar and several buttons below the neck. Polo players originally wore this style, which is now common in casual and semi-formal clothing.

cardigan.definition: Knitted jacket that is fastened up the front with buttons or a zipper.

pullover.definition: A sweater that is put on by pulling it over the head.

vest.definition: A man's sleeveless garment worn underneath a coat.

jeans.definition: (used in the plural) close-fitting trousers of heavy denim for manual work or casual wear.

pants.definition: (used in the plural) underpants worn by women.

shorts.definition: (used in the plural) trousers that end at or above the knee.

skirt.definition: Cloth covering that forms the part of a garment below the waist.

leggings.definition: A garment covering the leg (usually extending from the knee to the ankle).
leggings.exampleUsage: The glossary uses the term "Leggings" in an educational description.

cargo-pants.definition: Loose trousers with several large pockets, especially on the sides of the legs.
cargo-pants.exampleUsage: He wore cargo pants with large side pockets.

khakis.definition: A military uniform made of khaki fabric.

capris.definition: An island (part of Campania) in the Bay of Naples in southern Italy.

culottes.definition: Loose shorts that look like a skirt when worn.

jacket.definition: A short outer garment worn over other clothes.

raincoat.definition: A waterproof coat worn in rainy weather.

windbreaker.definition: A lightweight jacket designed to block the wind.

parka.definition: A warm coat, often with a hood, worn in cold weather.

blazer.definition: A smart jacket worn as part of a suit or with other clothes.

trench-coat.definition: A long overcoat made from water-resistant fabric usually has a belt, wide lapels, and two overlapping rows of buttons.

puffer-jacket.definition: A warm jacket filled with insulating material and divided into padded sections.
puffer-jacket.exampleUsage: She wore a puffer jacket on the cold morning.

denim-jacket.definition: A casual jacket made from denim fabric.
denim-jacket.exampleUsage: His denim jacket has metal buttons.

fleece.definition: Tanned skin of a sheep with the fleece left on.

sundress.definition: A light loose sleeveless summer dress with a wide neckline and thin shoulder straps that expose the arms and shoulders.

maxi-dress.definition: A long dress that usually reaches the ankles or floor.
maxi-dress.exampleUsage: She chose a simple maxi dress for the daytime event.

mini-dress.definition: A short dress with a hem well above the knee.
mini-dress.exampleUsage: The costume display included a brightly colored mini dress.

jumpsuit.definition: One-piece garment fashioned after a parachutist's uniform.

romper.definition: A person who romps or frolics.

overalls.definition: (usually plural) work clothing consisting of denim trousers (usually with a bib and shoulder straps).

tracksuit.definition: Matching everyday clothes include a jacket and pants for sports, trips, or rest.

uniform.definition: Special clothes worn by students at a school.

onesie.definition: A one-piece outfit covers the body and often the legs. Babies commonly wear onesies, while adults may wear them for relaxing or fun.

underwear.definition: Undergarment worn next to the skin and under the outer garments.

bra.definition: An undergarment worn by women to support their breasts.

socks.definition: Hosiery consisting of a cloth covering for the foot.

undershirt.definition: A collarless men's undergarment for the upper part of the body.

boxer-shorts.definition: Loose-fitting underwear or shorts shaped like traditional boxing trunks.
boxer-shorts.exampleUsage: The clothing guide lists boxer shorts as one type of underwear.

nightgown.definition: Lingerie consisting of a loose dress designed to be worn in bed by women.

bathrobe.definition: A loose piece of clothing worn before or after taking a bath.
